kernel_migration.equivalence_check: 3,741 sealed holdout rows recomputed; zero per-field difference

scorer.approximation_notice: Research approximation of the Armantier et al. (2017) Appendix C generalized-beta fit, selected on a preregistered holdout; not the official FRBNY implementation. The same algorithm scores real and simulated questionnaires; differences from official headline values are reported separately.

limits: Entrant and returner groups differ observationally; this is not an initialization treatment effect.
No nationwide 50/50 aggregate; two repeats are not twice as many respondents.
Entrant baseline retains an assigned synthetic state, not that persons true previous answer.
No actual entrant delta or synthetic matched-person accuracy claim; distribution metrics prioritized.
Three seen months, 24 per group, one donor/news assignment; descriptive pilot only.
Normal statistical expansion is not included in this trial.
